confirm.description: Whether to ask for confirmation before destructive operations

delim1.description: Field delimiter for structured data output (cannot be unset)

delim2.description: Array item delimiter for structured data output (cannot be unset)

pager.description: Pager command to use (e.g., 'less -R'); unset if empty

blocksize.description: Block size in bytes (0 = use default)

filemode.description: Octal file mode for newly created database files

coalesce.description: Merge adjacent free blocks (true/false); null = leave unset

centfree.description: Enable central free block pool (true/false); null = leave unset

defines.description: List of structured data type definitions (key or content). Each define has type and members list.

defines.items.description: A single data structure definition (key or content).

defines.items.members.description: List of member declarations in this structure.

defines.items.members.items.size.description: Array size (if array type, e.g., char id[3]).

defines.items.members.items.offset.description: Explicit offset (in bytes) where this member begins.

defines.items.members.items.pad.description: Number of padding bytes to add before this member.
